hypothesis: Five fixed causal states improve t1 calibration of fixed fold-bound GRU256 beyond affine calibration.
sample: Separately rank unique calibration and evaluation components by SHA256('strong-offset-v1:'+str(component)); take first128 in each pool and all their sequences. No score-dependent changes. Record cutoff before scores.
fit: Scored calibration rows only; clip y +/-2, weightedMSE weights abs(clipped y)+.001 matching nonlinear probe; unpenalized intercept and raw prediction coefficient; sole fixed state ridge .001*N; affine uses identical fit rows/weights and same zero penalty on its shared coefficients.
preprocessing: Unweighted state means/std on selected calibration rows only; std+1e-6; updates use every input row; initial book age10001; zero-initial EWMA. No evaluation normalization.
intervention: ONLY t1 for affine and offset; t0 copied bit-identically from parent.
metric: global_wp_clip2_v1; finite float32 predictions; clip y,p +/-2; exact weights abs(clipped y); all need_prediction AND is_scored rows; additive moments pooled globally.
bootstrap: 1000 paired connected-component draws, seed271828; report observed mean-of-target delta and bootstrap mean, SD, percentile95CI; t1 CI also.
gate: Offset minus affine t1 >=.005, positive in both eval folds, average delta paired component CI lower>0, and offset average greater than raw. Otherwise reject strong-baseline transport on this exposed exploratory panel. No tuning if null.
tests: Input-only full versus prefix features and independent nonlinear source parity; weighted metric parity against frozen scorer; component disjointness, sidecars/checkpoints/model provenance/cache/parquet alignment; t0 invariance.
limits: CPU1core2GiB15min wrapper; no GPU/training/install/source/ledger/submission changes. Exposed validation, not fresh/public confirmation. Parent fits for other folds may include evaluation components; calibration targets are disjoint but not nested parent-training-independent. Report this limitation.
